title: Cross-sectional resilience after BTC deleveraging shocks

inputs: daily metrics archives containing 5m open interest
data.metrics_download_rule: after preregistration, derive BTC shock event dates from contract prices only; request each event UTC date and its previous UTC date for every symbol
data.quality_policy: fail on corrupt ZIP, invalid or duplicate required row, non-contiguous monthly 5m price series, missing required archive, or missing event-time price/OI/mark data

event.shock_return: log return from the first bar open through the sixth bar close
event.zscore_method: current shock return minus mean of the prior 8640 overlapping 30m returns, divided by their sample standard deviation
event.event_time: first 5m boundary after the completed six-bar shock window

portfolio.liquidity_measure: sum of quote volume strictly before the 30m shock window
portfolio.shock_residual: symbol 30m log return minus prior-window beta times BTC 30m log return
portfolio.oi_change: log sum_open_interest change from event_time minus 30m to event_time
portfolio.resilience_score: cross-sectional percentile rank of shock residual plus percentile rank of negative OI change
portfolio.initial_alt_weights: three longs total +0.5 and three shorts total -0.5
portfolio.btc_hedge: negative of the selected alt portfolio prior-window beta exposure
portfolio.normalization: divide all signed weights, including BTC hedge, by total absolute weight
portfolio.decision_time: event_time when the period-end OI record is observable
portfolio.entry_time: contract 5m open exactly 5 minutes after event_time
portfolio.exit_time: contract 5m open exactly 125 minutes after event_time
portfolio.overlap: global 24h event cooldown prevents overlapping portfolios

execution.fees: each leg charged on its own entry and exit simulated fill notional
execution.funding: charge every realized event using event mark-price proxy when entry_time <= funding_time < exit_time

interpretation.pass: eligible only for a point-in-time full-universe development replication and event-time placebo
interpretation.fail: eliminate this exact specification; any shock threshold, score, leg count or holding-period change requires a new experiment id
interpretation.known_bias: the fixed 16-symbol diagnostic panel is survivor-selected and cannot support a deployable universe claim
